title: Teams chat: new JC 311 CLA for Nordwind Retail BE

messages.body: Heads-up for everyone handling Nordwind Retail BE: the new JC 311 CLA applies from 1 September 2026. Sunday overtime is now paid at a 120% premium on top of the hourly wage (it was 100%). Weekday overtime stays at 50%. I'll update the client file on SharePoint once Nordwind signs off the payroll config.
Thanks Lotte! Does that also apply to student workers?
Yes, students included. Payroll config for October is being updated.
